# LocalToolBox

> LocalToolBox is an open-source, privacy-first toolbox of 316 browser utilities across 16 categories. All processing runs client-side in the browser. No accounts, no uploads, no watermarks, no ads. A few network tools (DNS, WHOIS, IP info...) are clearly labeled. AI tools download a local model once, cache it, and then work offline.

## Info pages

- [About](http://localhost:5173/about): mission and privacy stance
- [Privacy](http://localhost:5173/privacy): what stays on your device (everything except labeled network lookups)
- [Terms](http://localhost:5173/terms): terms of use
- [Contact](http://localhost:5173/contact): feedback and questions

## Categories

- [PDF Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/pdf): Create, convert, and manipulate PDF files (12 tools)
- [Image Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/image): Edit, convert, and optimize images (30 tools)
- [Video & Audio](http://localhost:5173/category/video): Convert, trim, and extract audio from video — right in your browser (30 tools)
- [Text Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/text): Analyze, transform, and format text (42 tools)
- [Developer Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/developer): Code formatters, encoders, and developer utilities (59 tools)
- [Math & Numbers](http://localhost:5173/category/math): Calculations, conversions, and number tools (20 tools)
- [Converters](http://localhost:5173/category/converters): Convert between units, formats, and types (17 tools)
- [Color Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/color): Pick, convert, and work with colors (14 tools)
- [Crypto & Security](http://localhost:5173/category/crypto): Hash, encrypt, and decode data (12 tools)
- [Network Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/network): IP, DNS, URL, and network utilities (14 tools)
- [File Tools](http://localhost:5173/category/file): File utilities, generators, and converters (9 tools)
- [Generators](http://localhost:5173/category/generators): Generate UUIDs, passwords, data, and more (15 tools)
- [SEO & Web](http://localhost:5173/category/seo): Meta tags, sitemaps, and SEO utilities (8 tools)
- [Time & Date](http://localhost:5173/category/time): Date, time, timezone, and duration tools (14 tools)
- [Finance](http://localhost:5173/category/finance): Currency, loan, investment calculators (14 tools)
- [Social & Media](http://localhost:5173/category/social): Social media tools and analytics helpers (6 tools)
